newsitem.title: GERMANY: Linde looks forward to higher 97 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Linde looks forward to higher 97 earnings.

text.p: German forklift truckmaker Linde AG said on Thursday that it was looking forward to an improvement in profitability in 1997, accompanied by a sales increase of over five percent.
The main impetus behind growth was coming from the group's foreign business, management board chairman Hans Meinhardt told a news conference.
In the first two months of the current year sales grew 6.4 percent to 1.206 billion marks, while incoming orders grew 10.8 percent to 14.75 billion marks.

Last week Linde, Europe's top forklift truck maker, reported an 11.1 percent increase in pre-tax profits to 689.1 million marks in 1996, while sales in the period rose 6.2 percent to 8.8 billion marks.
